metadata.title: दाल-पानिया: स्वाद और परंपरा का अनोखा खाना | Dal-Paniya:A Traditional Tribal Dish from Madhya Pradesh
metadata.description: Dal-Paniya is a delicious and nutritious meal widely prepared in the tribal regions of Madhya Pradesh. More than just food, it is an integral part of the cultural heritage of the Bhil, Bhilala, and Barela tribes. While its exact origin is hard to trace, this episode of Tribal Kitchen delves into the socio-economic conditions that gave rise to this humble yet wholesome dish. Watch this special episode to discover the story behind Dal-Paniya and the deep-rooted traditions it represents.
